## Problem

What operator or developer problem does this solve?

## Proposal

What should change (scope, files, API or console view if any).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why they were not chosen.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Covered by offline tests (`tmp_path` fixtures, no network)
- [ ] Dashboard stays read-only and stdlib-only (if it touches `dashboard/`)
- [ ] Documented in the final summary (what entered / what stayed out and why)
